note: Alberta Parks recreation area at Swan Lake, ~40 km southwest of Rocky Mountain House: one loop of mostly treed sites back from a reed-fringed shore, with a boat launch, pier and fish-cleaning station. Trophy trout/pike lake, electric motors/canoes only. OHVs must stay on their trailers until they reach the nearby trail systems and staging areas; riding or offloading in the park is prohibited. Bring firewood. Cell reception is limited. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated May 29, 2026): 24 unserviced FCFS sites C$28 (text says 22), non-potable pumps, no firewood; season written May 14 - Sep 8 (was approximate). Recommend lakeview -> not waterfront (pads behind spruce and a reed marsh, open water 70-120 m).
flags: WATERFRONT: recommend lakeview -> NOT WATERFRONT. Imagery (0.33 m/px crop around 52.1210,-115.1925): the lake-side pads (tear sheet sites 4-9 on the loop's lake side, 1-3 at the east end) sit behind a row of spruce. Beyond it a wet margin and a wide reed bed run out to open water. Pad to reed edge is ~25-35 m through trees; pad to open water is ~70-120 m. Sites 1-3 are ~65 m from open water by the dock, through trees and reeds. The only official photo is a lake scene, not a campsite. The view claim rests on the page's marketing line 'a few choice sites located next to the lake', which cannot carry it alone. No open sightline from a numbered pad could be confirmed, so it goes down. Lead: if a reviewer finds an official photo from sites 5-8 showing open water, lakeview could stand.
